feed_anomaly.title: Feed use differs from normal ({{date}})
feed_anomaly.body: On {{date}}, {{actual}} kg of feed per head was given, against an average of {{expected}} kg on earlier days. Difference {{direction}}{{deviation}}%. Check the record and the feeding.

mortality_spike.title: Sharp rise in deaths
mortality_spike.body: {{dead}} head died in the last 7 days, against a usual {{expected}} a week. Find the cause with the veterinarian.

weight_slowdown.title: {{herd}}: weight gain has slowed
weight_slowdown.body: Daily gain at the last weighing was {{latestG}} g, against an earlier average of {{previousG}} g. Check the ration and the animals' health.

weight_loss.title: {{count}} head lost weight
weight_loss.body: These lost more than 8% between the last two weighings: {{tags}}. This can be a sign of illness, so have the veterinarian look at them.

fuel_spike.title: {{asset}}: fuel use has risen
fuel_spike.body: On {{date}} it used {{actual}} l per motor-hour, against a usual {{expected}} l. Difference +{{deviation}}%. Check the machine and the records.

expense_spike.title: {{category}} spending rose ({{month}})
expense_spike.body: {{actual}} {{currency}} was spent in {{month}}, against an average of {{expected}} {{currency}} in earlier months. Difference +{{deviation}}%.

lambing_workload.title: Lambing workload: {{ewes}} ewes
lambing_workload.body: About {{lambs}} lambs are expected. The busiest week starts {{peakWeek}} ({{peakEwes}} ewes) and needs {{workers}} workers. The lactation ration needs a further {{extraFeedT}} t of feed.

season_profit.title: {{season}}: expected profit {{profit}} {{currency}}
season_profit.body: Expected revenue {{revenue}} {{currency}}, cost {{cost}} {{currency}}. This covers {{covered}}% of the area. {{skipped}} plans have no price, yield or cost data.

feed_shortage.title: {{item}} will not last the winter
feed_shortage.body: Stock lasts {{days}} days and runs out on {{runOut}}. {{winterDays}} days of winter housing need another {{shortageT}} t. Buy by {{purchaseBy}}.

feed_cost_saving.title: {{ration}}: a cheaper mix is possible
feed_cost_saving.body: Replacing 10% of the dry matter from {{from}} with {{to}} saves about {{savingPerDay}} {{currency}} a day ({{head}} head). The zootechnician should judge whether it suits the animals.

crop_suggestion.title: Crop suggestion for next season
crop_suggestion.body: A suggestion is ready for {{fields}} fields. For example, field {{field}}: {{crop}}, expected profit {{margin}} {{currency}}/ha. Based on planned yields and costs.

lambing_workload_no_feed.title: Lambing workload: {{ewes}} ewes
lambing_workload_no_feed.body: About {{lambs}} lambs are expected. The busiest week starts {{peakWeek}} ({{peakEwes}} ewes) and needs {{workers}} workers.

season_profit_complete.title: {{season}}: expected profit {{profit}} {{currency}}
season_profit_complete.body: Expected revenue {{revenue}} {{currency}}, cost {{cost}} {{currency}}. This covers every plan.

page.title: AI analysis and assistant
page.description: Questions about your farm data, automatic analysis and recommendations
page.notConfiguredTitle: The AI assistant is not set up yet
page.notConfiguredBody: Questions and document reading are unavailable for now. Statistical analysis and recommendations work without a key.
page.notConfiguredHow: To turn it on, set GEMINI_API_KEY (from a billing-enabled Google project) or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the server settings and restart the API.

chat.emptyDescription: The assistant only reads data and never changes anything. Each answer shows its sources and confidence.

coverage.title: Data readiness

help.safetyTitle: Nothing is written until you confirm
help.safetyBody: The assistant only prepares a record. If something is wrong, change or cancel it. A record below the approval threshold can be undone for 15 minutes.
help.elsewhere: Salaries, loan instalments and sales are entered in their own sections: recorded here, they would count twice.

field.qty: How much was it in quantity?

code.USE_OTHER_MODULE: This is entered in its own section: recorded here, it would count twice.
code.SAME_ACCOUNT: Both accounts are the same. Which account did it go to?
code.NO_ACCOUNT: No account has been added yet. Add one in Finance first.
code.UNIT_MISMATCH: The quantity or price is in another unit than the item is kept in. Give it in the item's unit, or give the total.
code.DATE_IN_FUTURE: The date cannot be in the future. Which day was it?
code.AMOUNT_CONFLICT: Your words and the document give different amounts. Which is right?
code.AMOUNT_AMBIGUOUS: The quantity at that price comes to another total. Which amount is right?
code.AMOUNT_NOT_STATED: Your words do not give this amount. How much was it?
code.QUANTITY_NOT_STATED: Your words do not give this quantity. How much was it?
code.PRICE_UNIT_UNCLEAR: Is that price per tonne or per kilo?
code.NOT_HAPPENED: Has this money already been paid? If so, say when.
code.WAGE_OR_SERVICE: Is this someone's wage, or payment for a service? Wages are entered in Payroll.
code.NO_OPEN_DEBT: There is no open debt with them in that direction. What was this payment?
code.MORE_THAN_OWED: That is more than is owed. What was the rest for?
code.ACCOUNT_CURRENCY: This account is kept in another currency. Which account was it, or how much in its currency?
code.CURRENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED: This is recorded here in one currency only. An exchange between currencies is entered in Finance.
code.CURRENCY_UNSUPPORTED: This currency is not kept here. Give the amount in the farm's currency, {{base}}.
